 News OPPO 11.11 Sale Cuts Up to PhP8,000 and Adds a Disneyland Raffle

 The OPPO 11.11 Sale is live on Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop until November 13, 2026, with discounts of up to PhP8,000 on select devices. OPPO attached the sale to its Maligayang PaskOPPO Christmas campaign , which starts on November 11 and puts two five-day, four-night Hong Kong Disneyland trips, each worth PhP500,000, into a single national raffle. The sale window opened on November 1.
 What the OPPO 11.11 Sale cuts on each platform
 Lazada carries the longest list. The Reno16 Series goes down by PhP8,000, the Reno12 Pro by PhP7,000, the Reno14 Pro by PhP6,000, the Reno13 by PhP5,000, and the Find X9 by PhP4,000. Below those, the A6s takes PhP3,000 off, the Pad SE, Bubble, and A6c take PhP2,000, and the Reno15 5G, A6t, Enco Air5, and Enco Air5s take PhP1,000.
 Shopee keeps the PhP8,000 Reno16 Series and PhP4,000 Find X9 cuts, then adds PhP2,000 off the Bubble and PhP1,000 off the Enco Air5 and Air5s. TikTok Shop matches both headline cuts and also takes PhP2,000 off the Pad SE, A6x, and A6t.
 The OPPO Reno16 Series carries the biggest single discount in the 11.11 run. Image: OPPO Philippines 
 OPPO is pushing the Reno16 Series hardest this season, and our launch coverage covers its four 50MP cameras. The Pad SE, PhP2,000 off on two platforms, is the cheaper add-on for buyers who want a bigger screen for editing and streaming.
 Free gifts stacked on top of the discounts
 Select purchases also ship with accessories. The Pad SE comes with a free Pad SE case, the Reno16 Series and Reno15 Series each come with a 10,000mAh power bank, and the Watch S comes with a spare strap. Buyers of the A7 Pro 5G get Tango Jet Earbuds worth PhP1,699 while stocks last, plus PhP100 GCash cashback until December 11.
 The OPPO A7 Pro 5G ships with free Tango Jet Earbuds during the 11.11 Sale. Image: OPPO Philippines 
 How the Maligayang PaskOPPO raffle works
 Entry takes three steps, which OPPO calls carols. First, pre-register through the Maligayang PaskOPPO Digital Caroling Pass at any participating OPPO official online store. Second, buy an eligible OPPO smartphone and link it to the My OPPO App to join the AGUINALDOPPO Instant Draw. Third, comment on the designated Maligayang PaskOPPO thread in the My OPPO App PH Circle.
 Each eligible My OPPO user can complete one pass and earn one grand raffle entry for the whole promotion, no matter how many phones are bought. The grand draw runs on January 31, 2027, and picks 1,277 winners under DTI Fair Trade Permit FTEB-271140, series of 2026. Beyond the two Disneyland trips, the pool includes OPPO A3x, Reno12 Pro 5G, and A5 Pro or A6t Pro units, OnePlus Nord Buds2 and Enco Buds2 Pro earbuds, YOOSE shavers, SMAC points, and Grab, SM, ShopeePay, and GCash vouchers.
 A separate early raffle runs until November 10 at 11:59 PM, with one entry per OPPO device bought from the official stores on the three platforms. Eleven winners get a piece of travel luggage, drawn on November 27.
 The catch is timing rather than mechanics. The discounts end on November 13, while a raffle entry only counts once the phone is linked to the My OPPO App and the community comment is posted. Prices also differ per platform, so compare the final cart total before paying. Our 10.10 sale coverage shows how much these tiers move between campaigns.
